verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.pt: Diga Israel: Desde minha juventude muitas vezes me afligiram.
verses.en_web: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young (let Israel now say);

verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.pt: Desde minha juventude, muitas vezes me afligiram, porém não prevaleceram contra mim.
verses.en_web: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.en_bbe: Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young, but my troubles have not overcome me.

verses.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.pt: Lavradores lavraram sobre minhas costas, fizeram compridos os seus sulcos.
verses.en_web: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
verses.en_bbe: The ploughmen were ploughing on my back; long were the wounds they made.

verses.en: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é justo; ele cortou as cordas dos perversos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is true: the cords of the evil-doers are broken in two.

verses.en: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.pt: Sejam envergonhados, e voltem para trás todos os que odeiam a Sião.
verses.en_web: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
verses.en_bbe: Let all the haters of Zion be shamed and turned back.

verses.en: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.pt: Sejam como a erva dos telhados, que se seca antes que cresça.
verses.en_web: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up;
verses.en_bbe: Let them be like the grass on the house-tops, which is dry before it comes to full growth.

verses.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.pt: Com que o ceifeiro não enche sua mão, nem o braço daquele que amarra os molhos.
verses.en_web: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
verses.en_bbe: He who gets in the grain has no use for it; and they do not make bands of it for the grain-stems.

verses.en: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
verses.pt: Nem também os que passam, dizem: A bênção do SENHOR seja sobre vós; nós vos bendizemos no nome do SENHOR. Cântico dos degraus:
verses.en_web: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
verses.en_bbe: And those who go by do not say, The blessing of the Lord be on you; we give you blessing in the name of the Lord.
